Animated liquid fluid level wave in Hydration tracker

Glow pulsing bioluminescent cards with backdrop blur

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Ensure all interactive buttons, inputs, links, and cards have proper data-testid attributes.
Maintain theme consistency with deep ocean dark mode and bioluminescent cyan accents.
Mascot Mizuki must remain visible, expressive, and helpful throughout all main sections.
Do NOT use pure black background #000000; use dark slate navy tint #030712 / #091322.
Do NOT use generic Inter font for main headings; use Outfit or Plus Jakarta Sans with tracking-tight.
All cards must have glass backdrop filters (backdrop-blur-md or backdrop-blur-xl) with fine semi-transparent borders.
Include micro-interactions, hover glow effects, fluid wave transitions, and sound/visual toggles.
